channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Opinion: Here’s what’s next in California’s unusually crowded governor’s race
item.description: The lack of a clear frontrunner at this stage of the campaign is not only an unusual phenomenon, but it creates a raft of potential scenarios.

item.title: Cherryfish blends modern Japanese flavors in Pacific Beach
item.description: Cherryfish, a new upscale restaurant in Pacific Beach, pays careful attention to both the dining and the experience.

item.title: No imminent drone threat to California, says governor
item.description: Police in Los Angeles and San Francisco said they were monitoring world events for any risks to their cities.

item.title: Discussing his dyslexia, Newsom steps into K–12 spotlight
item.description: At an event to promote his new memoir, the California Democrat revealed that he “cannot read a speech” and feels he hasn’t overcome dyslexia.

item.title: Deported DACA recipient files federal lawsuit seeking return to California
item.description: A deported DACA recipient is asking a federal court to order her immediate return to the U.S., challenging the lawfulness of her speedy removal.

item.title: The field is set: Meet the candidates officially running for California governor
item.description: The secretary of state’s office says it will verify the paperwork their campaigns submitted and publish an official list of primary candidates by March 21.

item.title: Navore Market hub offers La Jolla residents fresh food from San Diego farms
item.description: Navore Market launched its first aggregation hub in La Jolla on Jan. 14 at the La Jolla United Methodist Church, giving residents a single location to pick up fresh, locally grown food from multiple San Diego farms through the company’s online platform.

item.title: Wave FC added Ludmila and shook up the roster. There might be another big name to come
item.description: Over the past three months, Wave FC has undergone a substantial makeover, saying goodbye to nearly 10 veterans.

item.title: A rice cooker and a local church bring Hawaii’s ‘aloha spirit’ to San Diego
item.description: Pastor Gordon Wong he brings the spirit of his home state, Hawaii, to his San Diego church, Mission Church.

item.title: Police ramp up patrols outside places of worship after Michigan synagogue shooting
item.description: SDPD: "Our goal is to ensure all members of our religious communities here in San Diego are safe to gather and practice their faith."
